Shortcuts

BBrush in Edit Tools, or Mask Brush when Mask is active
PPencil tool
EEraser tool
GPaint Bucket tool
WMagic Wand tool
DDropper tool
Ctrl/CmdTemporary color picker while using Pencil tools
HHide Mask on/off
FReset view, or fit the Compositor timeline when hovering it
Mouse WheelZoom preview canvas
Shift + WheelAdjust active brush or pencil size
Left / RightPrevious/next frame, or previous/next Compositor frame
Shift + ArrowsMove the current frame, or selected Compositor clips
EnterPlay/Pause
SpaceFullscreen preview
DeleteDelete selected frame(s), or selected Compositor clip
BackspaceDelete selected frame(s), or selected Compositor clip
Ctrl/Cmd + DDuplicate selected Compositor clip(s)
Ctrl/Cmd + ZUndo
Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + ZRedo
Ctrl/Cmd + YRedo
EscapeClose modal/menu or cancel the active picker
Shift + ClickSelect a range of frames or Compositor clips
Ctrl/Cmd + ClickToggle frame or Compositor clip selection

About Spritesheet Editor

Spritesheet Editor is a focused browser-based workflow for preparing, editing, referencing, compositing, and exporting sprite animation assets.

Developed by RenderPop Studio
Studio https://renderpopstudio.com/
Official Spritesheet Editor Site https://renderpopstudio.com/SpritesheetEditor/
Current Release Version 1.5.0

Built for animation cleanup, reference matching, palette workflows, bitmap font work, and compositor-driven sprite exports.
